question.text: Which atomic species cannot be used as a nuclear fuel?

solution.text: Among the given options, ${ }_{92} \mathrm{U}^{238}$ is an isotope of uranium but cannot be used as a nuclear-fuel. U- 238 is non-fissile, i.e., it does not undergo fission by thermal neutrons. The energy released when U-238 absorbs a neutron is insufficient to carry out nuclear fission. Hence, (d) is the correct option.
